subject.title: improve(ui): move Devices into Settings and redesign the device inventory

question: Should Devices become Settings-only even though existing persisted sidebar pins are discarded during upgrade?
rationale: Moving the destination is an information-architecture choice, and there is no equivalent top-level pin after the move; code review cannot decide whether silently dropping that stored preference is acceptable product behavior.

options.title: Approve Settings-only migration
options.body: Accept removal of legacy Devices pins, retain the `/nodes` alias, and add explicit upgrade coverage documenting the intentional preference cleanup.

options.title: Preserve a navigation affordance
options.body: Keep or introduce a compatible pinned shortcut that routes existing Devices pins to the new Settings destination.

options.title: Separate redesign from route move
options.body: Land the inventory redesign while leaving Devices top-level until the navigation migration is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Approve Settings-only migration
recommendation.body: Accept removal of legacy Devices pins, retain the `/nodes` alias, and add explicit upgrade coverage documenting the intentional preference cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest observed ownership of this Control UI redesign and adjacent navigation behavior.
